title: Images and responsive media
description: Provide meaningful image descriptions, aspect-ratio dimensions, responsive sources and image loading hints without breaking offline rendering.
objectives: Choose informative alt text for meaningful images and empty alt for decoration
Prevent layout shifts by declaring intrinsic width and height
Explain picture, srcset and sizes in responsive image selection
Test that image resources load in a standalone local HTML document
rubric: I added meaningful alt text, dimensions and captions for informative media.
I tested a responsive picture and used empty alt for purely decorative art.
I passed image-source and responsive-markup tests.
